sourceChecks.text: Then David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, “Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp?” Abishai said, “I will go down with you.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がゼルヤの子、ヨアブの兄弟と明記し、ダビデの問いに「私が一緒に下ります」と答える。

sourceChecks.text: So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay around him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がダビデとともにサウルの陣へ下ったと述べる。

sourceChecks.text: Then Abishai said to David, “God has delivered up your enemy into your hand today. Now therefore please let me strike him with the spear to the earth at one stroke, and I will not strike him the second time.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文でアビシャイがサウルを槍で一撃する許可をダビデに求める。

sourceChecks.text: David said to Abishai, “Don’t destroy him, for who can stretch out his hand against the LORD’s anointed, and be guiltless?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文でダビデがサウルを殺してはならないとアビシャイに答える。
